question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute an ABS DWV piping system in lieu of the specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping per Section 22 13 16, submitting a cut sheet and third-party listing for review prior to fixture rough-in.
proposed_solution: Use an ABS DWV alternate piping system in lieu of the specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track
routing_rationale: The request involves a substitution of specified plumbing piping material, requiring review and approval by the plumbing engineer of record against the performance criteria in Section 22 13 16.
